text_block_list.text:
Just as all of Nishino Flower's training 
for the day had wrapped up—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um... Trainer-san! Could I run just a 
little bit more?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
When I looked back at my times from a 
while ago, I noticed they've actually 
gotten shorter!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"And when that happened, it really fired 
me up, or should I say, it made me want to 
run more and more...!"
choice_data_list: Sounds good, let's get some runs in!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
"And when that happened, it really fired 
me up, or should I say, it made me want to 
run more and more...!"
choice_data_list: Sounds good, let's get some runs in!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much! Well then, I'm off!

Nishino Flower happily kept on running 
that day until the sun went down.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I see... So simply training more isn't 
necessarily the answer...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
However, deep down, I just can't shake 
this desire to become faster and faster...
choice_data_list:
Running isn't the only way to train, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, classroom study! Thinking while 
running in a race is important too, isn't 
it!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could you stick with me for just 
a bit longer after this? I want you to 
teach me some racing tips!

Afterward, Nishino Flower diligently 
studied race footage in the Trainer's 
office until sundown.
